name: CloudZao Metalio E-Ink4 Plus (ESP32-S31, 4.7in 1216x684 EPD) — upstream display driver memory
_sources: docs/research/foundation/platform-runtime.md, upstream-firmware.md, docs/research/simulator/performance-modeling.md. Principle until calibrated: time costs take upper bounds, resources take lower bounds. Device measurements: docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md (phase 0, 2026-11-03).

cpu._coremark_source: ESP32-S31 datasheet v0.5: CoreMark 2195.20 dual-core @320 MHz = 3.43/MHz per core, which needs CPI ~1.0 with GCC 15.2; the closest plausible single-issue model (ISS, tools/iss) gives 3.083 — used here
cpu._notes_cache: I-cache 16 KiB per core, 2-way, 64 B lines; D-cache 64 KiB shared by both cores and by PSRAM and mapped flash (ESP-IDF soc.h / Kconfig.cache, see tools/iss/timing). icache_penalty: extra fraction on annotated system CPU for misses on flash-resident code (ISS: cold small kernels +30%, steady state lower; 0.15 pessimistic, 0.08 expected). flash.line_fill: one 64 B line over DIO 80 MHz flash (ISS flash.fill).

kernel._notes: CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100 upstream: delays/timeouts quantized to 10 ms. ctx switch 10 us / queue op 5 us are pessimistic estimates. FreeRTOS objects live in internal RAM (ESP-IDF).
kernel._notes_stack: host_stack_ratio 1.0 = use host (x86-64) stack use as-is: pessimistic for RV32 (smaller frames, same arrays). Authoritative check: -fstack-usage on the target build.

memory._notes: PESSIMISTIC DEFAULT. internal_heap_kib = internal RAM left for EVERYTHING allocated at run time (display driver buffers, task stacks, TLS, system) after static code/data, excluding the DMA reserve. dma_heap_kib = the upstream SPIRAM_MALLOC_RESERVE_INTERNAL pool: on the S31 (IDF 6.1) it is tried after regular internal RAM for DMA and internal requests and last for default ones; the dma_heap_kib >= 16 budget therefore measures what is left of the reserve, not a separate DMA pool. Static use is unknown until `idf.py size` (foundation 3.2): replace these numbers then. PSRAM: 16 MB measured on the device (docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md). The factory firmware confirms the 64 KiB reserve (boot log); its own static use is 226.7 KiB, a reference only until idf.py size on our build.
memory._notes_upstream: Upstream display pipeline needs ~120 KiB internal (127-line queues + 64 KiB LUT): this profile gives it a larger internal heap so it runs at all. Use it for TIMING comparisons only; memory numbers are not comparable.
memory._notes_regions: Sized so the upstream driver fits (timing comparison only). Measured factory layout (docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md): about 201 + 16 KiB of internal heap after the 64 KiB reserve.

display._notes_pmic: Keeps the fixed power_up_us model of the upstream pipeline (timing comparison only). panel_vcom_mv: E0470A14-AF VCOM 1200 mV (upstream config.h; factory boot log).
display._notes: phase >= 12 ms (EPD_MIN_PHASE_US), pessimistic 16 ms; line 17 us x 688 lines. Upstream 'balanced' default: GC16 36 / GL16 37 / DU 20 phases ('clear' = 48/48). TPS65185 power-up ~140 ms in upstream code (fixed 50+50 ms delays + PG polling), powered off after each refresh (keep_power false). During waveform playback two max-priority epd_prep feeder tasks occupy ~70% of each core. Driver internal 50 KiB is the design target (upstream ~120 KiB).
display._notes_pipeline: Upstream pipeline as shipped (render_lcd.c, epd_refresh.cc, metalio_epd.c): fixed odd/even line ownership, 192-line prefill, 127-slot queue per feeder, feeders spin (vTaskDelay(0)) on a full queue, LCD refill interrupt not IRAM-safe (CONFIG_LCD_RGB_ISR_IRAM_SAFE unset: masked during every flash operation), Draw() diffs the full screen, 'clean' = epd_clear_checked (69 frames) + 48-phase GC16, EPD_LUT_1K. line_prep_us 33.4 = upstream C (epdiy_riscv_ve_stub.c) on the ISS fitted model; consistent with upstream's note that a 64-line prefill underruns under concurrent audio. Device check (docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md): the factory firmware's EpdTiming reports 15.08-15.10 ms per full-screen phase, matching this profile's 15.1 ms.

input._notes: FT6336U on the shared 100 kHz I2C1 bus with IO expander, fuel gauge, charger, RTC, accelerometer. AI = BOOT key (pending D-19); home/prev/next are cover touch keys.
input._notes_detect: touch_detect_us: finger contact -> INT, estimate (controller scan period in monitor mode)
input._notes_monitor: FT6336U monitor mode (estimate, defaults not verified against the datasheet): after ~10 s without a touch the controller scans slowly (G_CTRL / TIME_ENTER_MONITOR / PERIODMONITOR registers); the first touch or cover key then waits up to one monitor period (<= 60 ms assumed) longer. i2c_background_idle_poll_ms: fuel gauge / charger polling while the system is idle.
input._notes_keys: Key sources (upstream config.h): AI = BOOT key on GPIO61 (direct); POWER/VOL+/VOL- on the TCA9555 IO expander (INT on GPIO2 shared with the accelerometer, then I2C reads on the shared bus); HOME/PREV/NEXT are cover keys read by the touch controller (finger at Y~1600, outside the panel): touch INT after touch_detect_us, I2C read, polling until release, paused like touch while the PMIC powers up.

flash._notes: Flash part measured: Puya PY25Q128HA (JEDEC 85 20 18, docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md); timing from its datasheet Ver0.3: program 0.5/2.4 ms per 256-byte page, 4 KiB erase 50/240 ms (typ/max). Other units may carry another part: check flash-id per device. IDF 6.1: one cache-off window per esp_flash_write chunk (CONFIG_SPI_FLASH_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE 8192 upstream; littlefs programs from its internal buffer = direct write), per erase and per read chunk; SPI1 moves <= 64 bytes per program/read command (spi_cmd_us each). A program command costs program_first_us + its share of the page time. Auto-suspend off: the part supports suspend (75h/7Ah, latency <= 30 us) but IDF v6.1's generic chip driver enables it only for XMC and FM parts, not vendor 0x85 (code check); erase yields only between the sectors of one multi-sector erase (littlefs erases one per call).
flash._notes_assets: assets partition (fonts, images) assumed 6 MiB of the 16 MiB flash next to 2 OTA app slots and /user; upstream fontpack alone is ~4.75 MiB

sd._notes: pessimistic: 4-bit 40 MHz theoretical 20 MB/s; S31 path uses a 4 KiB internal bounce buffer upstream

network._notes: estimates (unverified): LTE limited by the 2 Mbaud UART-Ethernet link; RRC idle after ~10 s, resume ~300 ms; TLS 1 session ~40 KiB PSRAM + ~6 KiB internal; esp_websocket_client task 4 KiB; event loop task 2.5 KiB
network._notes_stacks: Port decisions (internal RAM): the WebSocket client task (CONFIG_ESP_WS_CLIENT_TASK_STACK_IN_EXT_RAM, TCB stays internal) and the 4G UART-NIC task keep their stacks in PSRAM — neither calls the flash API. The upstream profile keeps them internal.

audio._notes: BH1098G clocks I2S (ESP is slave): 16 kHz, stereo 32-bit slots, DMA 4 x 240 frames per direction = 60 ms runway (upstream bt_audio_codec.cc). Mic has 2 channels (mic + loopback reference). Output start = I2S enable + NS4150 enable via the TCA9555 over the shared I2C + settle: estimate 30 ms. Opus state from the esp_audio_codec table (48 kHz stereo: enc 29.4 KB, dec 26.6 KB; 16 kHz mono needs less, kept pessimistic). Upstream audio_input task: 4 KB stack in PSRAM, priority 8 (frozen, like every task, while the flash API runs). Opus CPU per 60 ms frame is an ESTIMATE (enc ~12% of one 320 MHz core at complexity 0, dec ~2%); calibrate on the ISS or hardware.

power._notes: ALL ESTIMATES (unmeasured): replace with bench measurements (SP-14; standby SP-10). battery_mah 1700: upstream docs/battery-soc-and-charge.md (checked 2026-11-02) uses a 424860-2000 cell that delivered 1870.7 mAh at ~1 A to 3.3 V in their test; x0.9 for ageing and temperature (resources take lower bounds).
power._notes_clock: idle_mhz 320: upstream default (AppIdle 160/240/320, default 320, power_policy.h), i.e. no idle down-clocking.
power._notes_standby: Standby = explicit light sleep in slices (upstream: <= 60 s, esp_light_sleep_start). sleep_ma: whole board asleep with the shared P1.4 rail cut (chip + PSRAM retention + always-on parts: RTC, fuel gauge, IO expander, regulators). standby_modem_ma: extra while that rail stays up for answerable standby: the 4G module at short paging cycles 3.3-4.1 mA (vendor figure, foundation §7) plus the BH1098 on the same rail (unknown, ~1 mA assumed); SP-10 measures it. sleep_enter_ms 200 = upstream TPS65185 park (50 + 120 ms) + SD park + rails; sleep_exit_ms 30 = rails + key baseline; sd_remount_ms after a key wake only (upstream skips it on timer wakes); sleep_wake_us = chip wake-up (clock/PLL) before any task runs.

_notes_costs: costs_cycles: ISS Level-2 calibration (tools/iss, docs/research/simulator/iss-calibration.md, 2026-11-02): PESSIMISTIC values = max(raw x 1.3, slow corner) for copies, glyphs, conversion, JSON, inflate, CRC and the new glyph.px/fill.px/set_byte classes. Not measured on the ISS yet (kept as earlier guesses): lvgl.px, lvgl.refr, text.* (the ISS kernels are leaner than our text engine; measure system/text on the ISS next), heap.op (IDF heap wrapper not modelled), littlefs.op, tls.handshake, opus.*. CoreMark anchor 3.43/MHz needs CPI~1.0; fitted 3.083.
